bug.title: Clicking a docs screenshot navigates away to the bare image URL instead of opening it in an overlay on the page
bug.symptoms: ScreenshotFigure in apps/web/src/features/docs/markdown.tsx (~L189-215) wraps each chapter screenshot in <a href={screenshot.src}> ("Open full-size image: …"), so a click leaves /docs/{slug} for /docs/screenshots/{file}.webp: the reader loses their place, the caption and the site navigation, and has to press Back. markdown.tsx is rendered on the server (it is not a client module)
bug.reproduction_steps: Open http://localhost:3200/docs/your-account at 1440x900, scroll to "Sign in with a passkey" and click the screenshot: the browser navigates to /docs/screenshots/ch02-passkey-sign-in.webp
bug.expected: Per D1: a new client component screenshot-lightbox.tsx ("use client") renders the figure's link and image exactly as now (same href, alt, width, height, loading lazy, decoding async, classes, aria-label "Open full-size image: {alt}") and markdown.tsx's ScreenshotFigure uses it, so the server-rendered HTML and the no-JavaScript behaviour are unchanged. With JavaScript, a plain left click (no Ctrl, Meta, Shift or Alt, button 0) calls preventDefault and opens a <dialog> with showModal(): the dialog is labelled by the screenshot's caption (aria-labelledby), shows the image at full resolution scaled to fit the viewport (max 95vw by 90vh, object-fit contain, never wider than the page), the caption below it, and a Close button (aria-label "Close image", visible focus ring, at least 44px) that receives focus on open. Escape, the Close button and a click on the backdrop outside the image close it; focus then returns to the screenshot link; the URL does not change; the page behind does not scroll while it is open (overflow hidden on the root, restored on close). A modified click (Ctrl/Meta/Shift/middle) still opens the image the normal browser way. The backdrop is a dimmed token colour (::backdrop in docs.css, using tokens only; works in light and dark mode), the dialog has no horizontal scroll at 375px, and opening respects prefers-reduced-motion (no animation when reduced). Tests: screenshot-lightbox.test.tsx (jsdom: stub HTMLDialogElement.prototype.showModal and close if missing) asserts a click opens the dialog with the image, alt and caption and does not navigate (defaultPrevented), the Close button has focus, Escape/close returns focus to the link, a Ctrl-click is not intercepted, and the root overflow is restored on close; markdown.test.tsx keeps asserting the figure's link href and alt in the server markup (update the existing "links to the full-size image" test only as far as needed)
bug.actual: The screenshot opens as a separate page (the bare image URL)
